'''Ogveer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He helped [[Uff Wogo]] get off [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and took him to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was hunting Wogo due to the high bounty on his head.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ogveer appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
